statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The patient requires further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was performed
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary to capture electrocardiographic data during symptom onset
This diagnostic procedure is essential for accurate diagnosis and management of the conditions coded as I49.9 and R00.2
